findings.title: Food properly labeled; original container.
findings.comment: Observed bins of dry powders (flour, sugar, etc.) to be missing a label. PIC was informed that bins need a label bearing the common name of the food to avoid mistaken identification. Labels were added during the inspection. The violation is considered corrected-on-site.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.12 Food Storage Containers, Identified with Common Name of Food. Except for containers holding FOOD that can be readily and unmistakably recognized such as dry pasta, working containers holding FOOD or FOOD ingredients that are removed from their original packages for use in the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, such as cooking oils, flour, herbs, potato flakes, salt, spices, and sugar shall be identified with the common name of the FOOD.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used.
findings.comment: Observed multiple employee clothing items on shelves holding food items for the bakery (sprinkles and other decorative food items). Personal items pose a cross-contamination hazard with food. Ensure staff have a designated area for personal items such as a coat rack or locker.
findings.citation_text: 6-403.11(B) Designated Areas. (B) Lockers or other suitable facilities shall be located in a designated room or area where contamination of FOOD, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, LINENS, and SINGLESERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES can not occur.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: The caulking by the bakery hand sink has become unconnected from the sink. Ensure this seam is reapplied with fresh caulking to allow a nonabsorbent, smooth, and easily cleanable surface.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment:
Observed two steel containers on the left hand side of the prep table with no label. Label containers with the common name of product.
750-130f Unless its identity is unmistakable, bulk food such as cooking oil, syrup, salt, sugar or flour not stored in the product container or package in which it was obtained, shall be stored in a container identifying the food by common name.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Observed what appears to be mold on the seal of the mop sink. Clean and reseal sink to the wall.
750-1220 Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean. Clean the walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed food debris on top of the knife holder in the back bakery room. Clean non food contact surface.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment:
Observed two white bulk powders unlabeled. An employee labeled the containers to CORRECT the violation.
750-130f Unless its identity is unmistakable, bulk food such as cooking oil, syrup, salt, sugar or flour not stored in the product container or package in which it was obtained, shall be stored in a container identifying the food by common name.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Observed boxes in the walk in freezer were left open after removing food.  Boxes should be closed if not in use.  Close the boxes to protect the food.
750-120(a) Food shall be protected at all times. Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed ponding water near the mop sink.  Clean the ponding water.
750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment:
Observed coats stored on a shelf where empty food cartons are placed.  The coats were moved to another location to CORRECT the violation.
750-1390 Maintenance and cleaning tools such as brooms, mops, vacuum cleaners and similar equipment shall be maintained and stored in a way that does not contaminate food.
